mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to repair a rotted window frame in the Bay Area?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost to repair a rotted window frame in the Bay Area varies widely based on the extent of the damage, the type of window, and the complexity of the repair. Minor repairs might range from a few hundred dollars, while more extensive rot requiring significant structural work could cost over a thousand dollars per window. It's best to obtain a detailed estimate after an on-site assessment to understand the specific costs for your situation.
